sentences.text: Sharks live in every ocean.
Most people know they are old.
But how old?
Sharks are about four hundred million years old.
That is a very big number.
It is hard to feel.
So here is another way to say it.
Trees are younger than sharks.
Real trees, with wood, came later.
sentences.translationRu: Настоящие деревья, с древесиной, появились позже.

sentences.text: Sharks were already swimming.
The land was mostly empty then.
Small green plants, close to the ground.
sentences.translationRu: Мелкие зелёные растения у самой земли.

sentences.text: No forests. No flowers.
No animals with four legs on land.
Sharks are also older than Saturn's rings.
Probably. Scientists still argue about that.
sentences.translationRu: Вероятно. Учёные об этом ещё спорят.

sentences.text: They lived before the dinosaurs.
They lived with the dinosaurs.
And they are still here.
Five times almost everything died.
sentences.translationRu: Пять раз погибало почти всё живое.

sentences.text: Scientists call these mass extinctions.
Sharks got through all five.
Not the same kinds of shark.
sentences.translationRu: Не те же самые виды акул.

sentences.text: Many kinds died.
But the family did not.
Why are they so good at surviving?
Part of it is the body.
A shark has no bones.
Its body is made of something lighter.
sentences.translationRu: Её тело сделано из чего-то более лёгкого.

sentences.text: The same material as your ear.
sentences.translationRu: Из того же материала, что твоё ухо.

sentences.text: A light body needs less food.
And less food matters in a bad century.
sentences.translationRu: А это важно в плохом столетии.

sentences.text: Their teeth also never stop.
sentences.translationRu: И зубы у них не кончаются.

sentences.text: A shark loses teeth all the time.
New ones move forward from behind.
Some lose thirty thousand in a life.
sentences.translationRu: Некоторые теряют тридцать тысяч за жизнь.

sentences.text: So a broken tooth is not a problem.
For most animals, it is the end.

title: The desert is freezing at night

sentences.text: A desert is the hottest place you can stand.
sentences.translationRu: Пустыня — самое жаркое место, где можно стоять.

sentences.text: Fifty degrees in the afternoon.
The ground burns your hand.
Then the sun goes down.
And a few hours later it is freezing.
Sometimes below zero.
The same place, on the same day.
sentences.translationRu: То же место, в тот же день.

sentences.text: A difference of forty degrees is normal.
sentences.translationRu: Разница в сорок градусов — обычное дело.

sentences.text: People die of cold in deserts.
Which surprises almost everybody.
The reason is water.
Or rather, no water.
Air always holds some water as gas.
sentences.translationRu: В воздухе всегда есть вода в виде газа.

sentences.text: You cannot see it, but it is there.
sentences.translationRu: Её не видно, но она есть.

sentences.text: That water is a kind of blanket.
During the day the ground takes in heat.
At night it sends that heat upwards.
sentences.translationRu: Ночью она отдаёт это тепло вверх.

sentences.text: Water in the air catches some of it.
sentences.translationRu: Вода в воздухе часть его ловит.

sentences.text: And sends it back down.
So a wet night stays warm.
Desert air has almost no water in it.
sentences.translationRu: В воздухе пустыни воды почти нет.

sentences.text: So there is no blanket.
The heat goes straight up and away.
sentences.translationRu: Тепло уходит прямо вверх и прочь.

sentences.text: Into space, in a few hours.
Sand does not help either.
Sand holds heat very badly.
Water holds it well.
That is why the sea is cool in the day
and warm at night.
Sand does the opposite of that.
It gets hot fast and cold fast.
sentences.translationRu: Он быстро нагревается и быстро стынет.

sentences.text: Animals there live by the clock.
Many sleep underground all day.
sentences.translationRu: Многие весь день спят под землёй.

sentences.text: Half a metre down it is always mild.
They come out in the evening.
And go back before the night is deep.
Two or three good hours.
The rest of the day is too much of something.

title: Why cyclists ride so close together

sentences.text: Watch a cycling race on television.
The riders are in a tight group.
Wheels almost touching.
It looks dangerous, and it is.
sentences.translationRu: Выглядит опасно, и так и есть.

sentences.text: One small mistake and twenty riders fall.
sentences.translationRu: Одна маленькая ошибка — и падают двадцать.

sentences.text: So why do they do it?
The answer is air.
At forty kilometres an hour,
most of your work is pushing air.
Not the hill. Not the bike.
The air in front of you.
About four fifths of the effort.
The rider at the front pushes it all.
Behind him the air is messy and slow.
sentences.translationRu: Позади него воздух рваный и медленный.

sentences.text: It has already been moved.
So the second rider works less.
Maybe twenty per cent less.
In a big group it is even better.
A rider in the middle can save forty per cent.
sentences.translationRu: Гонщик в середине экономит до сорока процентов.

sentences.text: At the same speed.
Forty per cent over five hours
is the difference between finishing and not.
So the front is the worst place to be.
And teams take turns there.
sentences.translationRu: И команды меняются там по очереди.

sentences.text: A rider leads for a few minutes.
Then moves aside and drops back.
sentences.translationRu: Потом отходит в сторону и откатывается.

sentences.text: And rests inside the group.
This is why one rider alone
almost never stays ahead.
He is doing all the work.
The group behind is sharing it.
Even if he is stronger, the numbers win.
sentences.translationRu: Даже если он сильнее, побеждает арифметика.

sentences.text: The same thing happens with birds.
sentences.translationRu: То же самое происходит у птиц.

sentences.text: And with lorries on a motorway.
And with fish in a school.
Nobody taught any of them the physics.
They found it by being tired.
Eat a chilli and your mouth burns.
sentences.translationRu: Съешь перец чили — и рот горит.

sentences.text: You reach for water. It does not help.
Your eyes water. You start to sweat.
Everything your body does
is a response to being burned.
But nothing is burning.
The chilli is at room temperature.
No heat is being delivered at all.
Your mouth has heat sensors in it.
They exist to warn you about hot food.
sentences.translationRu: Они существуют, чтобы предупреждать о горячем.

sentences.text: Above about forty-three degrees
they send a pain signal.
Chilli contains a substance
that fits into those sensors directly.
sentences.translationRu: которое напрямую подходит к этим рецепторам.

sentences.text: It opens them without any heat.
sentences.translationRu: Оно открывает их без всякого тепла.

sentences.text: The sensor cannot tell the difference.
It reports fire, because that is all it can report.
sentences.translationRu: Он докладывает про огонь, потому что другого доклада у него нет.

sentences.text: Which is why water fails.
Water cools things down.
There is nothing here to cool.
Worse, the substance does not dissolve in water.
sentences.translationRu: Хуже того, вещество в воде не растворяется.

sentences.text: So water spreads it around your mouth.
sentences.translationRu: Так что вода разносит его по всему рту.

sentences.text: It does dissolve in fat.
Which is why milk works.
And why yoghurt is served with hot food
sentences.translationRu: И поэтому йогурт подают к острому

sentences.text: across most of the places that eat it.
Those cuisines worked this out
several centuries before the chemistry.
The plant did not invent this for us.
sentences.translationRu: Растение придумало это не для нас.

sentences.text: A chilli wants its seeds spread.
sentences.translationRu: Чили хочет, чтобы его семена разносили.

sentences.text: Birds do that well.
They swallow the fruit whole
and drop the seeds far away, undamaged.
Mammals chew, which destroys the seed.
sentences.translationRu: Млекопитающие жуют, а это губит семя.

sentences.text: Birds do not have that sensor at all.
sentences.translationRu: У птиц этого рецептора вовсе нет.

sentences.text: A chilli is silent to a bird.
The burn is a message with an address on it.
And the address is not us.

title: Why a microwave leaves cold spots

sentences.text: Heat food in a microwave and test it.
sentences.translationRu: Разогрей еду в микроволновке и попробуй.

sentences.text: One part is burning.
Another part is still cold.
This is not a broken machine.
It is how the machine works.
A microwave does not heat the air.
It does not heat the plate.
It sends out radio waves.
Water molecules absorb them.
And begin to move very fast.
Fast movement is what heat is.
So the water in the food heats itself.
sentences.translationRu: То есть вода в еде греет сама себя.

sentences.text: And everything around it warms up after.
sentences.translationRu: А всё вокруг нагревается уже потом.

sentences.text: This explains several odd things.
Dry bread barely warms.
A plate stays cool unless food touches it.
sentences.translationRu: Тарелка остаётся прохладной, если еда её не касается.

sentences.text: And frozen food heats unevenly
because ice absorbs much less than water.
sentences.translationRu: потому что лёд поглощает намного меньше воды.

sentences.text: So the first melted part races ahead.
sentences.translationRu: И первый растаявший участок вырывается вперёд.

sentences.text: The cold spots have a separate cause.
The waves bounce off the metal walls.
A wave going out meets a wave coming back.
Where two peaks meet, the wave is stronger.
sentences.translationRu: Где встречаются два гребня, волна сильнее.

sentences.text: Where a peak meets a trough, they cancel.
sentences.translationRu: Где гребень встречает впадину, они гасятся.

sentences.text: So the box contains a fixed pattern.
sentences.translationRu: В итоге в камере стоит устойчивый узор.

sentences.text: Hot regions and dead regions, in space.
sentences.translationRu: Горячие области и мёртвые, в пространстве.

sentences.text: They do not move.
Which is the entire reason for the turntable.
sentences.translationRu: В этом вся причина существования поворотного столика.

sentences.text: The pattern cannot be moved, so the food is.
sentences.translationRu: Узор сдвинуть нельзя, поэтому двигают еду.

sentences.text: You can see the pattern yourself.
Take the turntable out.
Cover a plate with chocolate.
Heat it for twenty seconds.
Melted patches appear in a row.
Measure the gap between them.
Double it, and multiply by the frequency
printed on the back of the machine.
You have just measured the speed of light.
sentences.translationRu: Ты только что измерил скорость света.

sentences.text: In a kitchen, with chocolate.

title: Humans gave up something to be able to speak

sentences.text: A baby can breathe and swallow at once.
sentences.translationRu: Младенец может одновременно дышать и глотать.

sentences.text: This is why feeding works.
It can drink continuously and keep breathing.
sentences.translationRu: Он может пить непрерывно и продолжать дышать.

sentences.text: Most mammals keep this ability for life.
sentences.translationRu: Большинство млекопитающих сохраняет это на всю жизнь.

sentences.text: A horse can drink and breathe together.
sentences.translationRu: Лошадь может пить и дышать одновременно.

sentences.text: A human adult cannot.
Somewhere between one and two years old
the arrangement inside the throat changes.
The larynx descends.
It moves down the neck, away from the nose.
sentences.translationRu: Она уходит вниз по шее, прочь от носа.

sentences.text: In other mammals it stays high.
sentences.translationRu: У других млекопитающих она остаётся высоко.

sentences.text: High enough to lock into the nasal passage.
sentences.translationRu: Достаточно высоко, чтобы смыкаться с носовым ходом.

sentences.text: Which makes two separate pipes.
Air through one, food through the other.
sentences.translationRu: Воздух по одной, еда по другой.

sentences.text: They never have to share.
In an adult human they do share.
There is a single passage at the back
that both air and food must cross.
sentences.translationRu: который пересекают и воздух, и еда.

sentences.text: A flap closes over the airway when you swallow.
sentences.translationRu: При глотании над дыхательным путём закрывается заслонка.

sentences.text: It works well, and not perfectly.
sentences.translationRu: Она работает хорошо, но не идеально.

sentences.text: Choking on food is a human speciality.
It kills thousands of people every year.
sentences.translationRu: Это убивает тысячи людей в год.

sentences.text: It is almost unknown in other mammals.
sentences.translationRu: У других млекопитающих это почти не встречается.

sentences.text: So an obvious question follows.
Why would evolution accept that?
The long-standing answer is speech.
A descended larynx leaves a large space
above it, in the throat.
That space can be reshaped by the tongue.
Different shapes produce different vowels.
An animal with a high larynx
has a much smaller range of sounds.
The trade would then be stark.
A risk of choking, in exchange for vowels.
sentences.translationRu: Риск подавиться в обмен на гласные.

sentences.text: The account has been challenged.
Some species with high larynxes
produce a wider range than expected.
sentences.translationRu: выдают более широкий диапазон, чем ожидалось.

sentences.text: And the descent may have other causes.
sentences.translationRu: И опускание могло иметь другие причины.

sentences.text: But the shape of the trade survives.
Something was given up.
And what was bought was worth it, at scale,
sentences.translationRu: И купленное того стоило, в масштабе,

sentences.text: to everybody except the individual who chokes.
sentences.translationRu: для всех, кроме того, кто подавился.

title: The job of speaking and listening at the same time

sentences.text: At an international meeting
somebody speaks, and everybody understands.
Not because they share a language.
sentences.translationRu: Не потому, что у них общий язык.

sentences.text: Because of people sitting in glass booths
sentences.translationRu: А из-за людей в стеклянных кабинах

sentences.text: at the back of the room.
Simultaneous interpreting is roughly eighty years old.
It was invented for the Nuremberg trials.
sentences.translationRu: Он был придуман для Нюрнбергского процесса.

sentences.text: Before that, interpreting was consecutive.
Somebody spoke, then stopped, then was translated.
sentences.translationRu: Человек говорил, останавливался, потом его переводили.

sentences.text: Which doubles the length of everything.
The trial could not afford that.
sentences.translationRu: Процесс не мог себе этого позволить.

sentences.text: So the equipment was built and people were trained.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому построили технику и обучили людей.

sentences.text: What the job requires is unusual.
The interpreter listens to a sentence
while speaking the previous one aloud.
Two language streams at once,
in opposite directions, continuously.
Most people cannot do this at all.
sentences.translationRu: Большинство людей так не может вообще.

sentences.text: Being bilingual is not sufficient.
It is not even the main qualification.
The hard part is not vocabulary.
It is prediction.
Languages put their verbs in different places.
sentences.translationRu: Языки ставят глаголы в разных местах.

sentences.text: German often holds the verb to the end.
sentences.translationRu: Немецкий часто держит глагол до конца.

sentences.text: So an interpreter into English
must begin an English sentence
before knowing what the speaker did.
They guess, from the shape of the sentence
and from what the meeting is about.
And they leave themselves an exit
in case the guess is wrong.
A famous joke in the trade
is the interpreter who ran out of sentence
sentences.translationRu: — про переводчика, у которого кончилась фраза,

sentences.text: and simply said: the speaker has made a joke,
sentences.translationRu: и он просто сказал: докладчик пошутил,

sentences.text: please laugh.
Booths are worked in pairs.
Twenty to thirty minutes each, then a swap.
Not because the work is unpleasant.
Because accuracy falls measurably after that
sentences.translationRu: А потому, что точность после этого измеримо падает,

sentences.text: and the interpreter does not notice it falling.
sentences.translationRu: а сам переводчик падения не замечает.

sentences.text: Which is the same finding
that governs air traffic control.
Any job where attention is the product
sentences.translationRu: Любая работа, где товар — это внимание,

sentences.text: ends up enforcing rest with a clock.

title: Soil is not dirt, and it takes centuries

sentences.text: Soil is treated as a background condition.
Something that is simply there, like weather.
sentences.translationRu: Чем-то, что просто есть, как погода.

sentences.text: It is closer to an organism.
And it is manufactured extremely slowly.
Start with what it is made of.
sentences.translationRu: Начнём с того, из чего она состоит.

sentences.text: Broken rock is only the frame.
What makes it soil is everything else.
Dead plant matter, partly decomposed.
The fungi and bacteria doing the decomposing.
sentences.translationRu: Грибы и бактерии, которые её разлагают.

sentences.text: And an enormous volume of empty space.
Around half of healthy soil is holes.
sentences.translationRu: Примерно половина здоровой почвы — это поры.

sentences.text: Air in some, water in others.
sentences.translationRu: В одних воздух, в других вода.

sentences.text: The holes are not a defect.
They are the working parts.
Roots grow into them, water moves through them,
sentences.translationRu: В них врастают корни, по ним движется вода,

sentences.text: and the organisms live in the films around them.
sentences.translationRu: а организмы живут в плёнках вокруг них.

sentences.text: Which is what makes compaction so serious.
Drive heavy machinery over a field
and the holes close.
Nothing has been removed.
The chemistry is unchanged.
The soil has simply stopped working.
Now the timescale.
Estimates vary with climate and rock,
sentences.translationRu: Оценки зависят от климата и породы,

sentences.text: but the numbers are consistently uncomfortable.
Somewhere between a century and a millennium
to produce a few centimetres.
Erosion can remove that in a single storm
sentences.translationRu: Эрозия может смыть их за одну бурю

sentences.text: from a field that has been left bare.
Which is the entire problem in one sentence.
sentences.translationRu: В одной фразе это и есть вся проблема.

sentences.text: Formation is geological. Loss is meteorological.
The rates differ by several orders of magnitude.
What is encouraging is how much is reversible
if the loss has not already happened.
Keeping something growing in the ground
through the whole year rather than half of it.
Disturbing it less.
Letting roots and fungi rebuild the structure
sentences.translationRu: Дать корням и грибам отстроить структуру,

sentences.text: that ploughing takes apart.
None of that is new knowledge.
sentences.translationRu: Ничего из этого не новое знание.

sentences.text: It is mostly older than the machinery
sentences.translationRu: Оно по большей части старше техники,

sentences.text: that made ignoring it possible.
